how: checks/cim_overlap.py, main's own build from the definition (zero modes of flux 3, 3 and 6 on the torus, the overlap by quadrature only, nothing of the seat's imported or run): the modes solve the zero-mode equation and are orthonormal; at 12 cases (four moduli; points of orders 5, 10, 15; up, down, lepton) the integrand is doubly periodic (2e-13), the images of all three fields under tau + 1 and -1/tau lie in the span of the modes (transport unitary to 6e-14), and Y at tau + 1 and at -1/tau equals the transported Y (3.5e-14, 3.9e-14); the transports are the diagonal exp(i pi (j + alpha)^2 / M) and the finite Fourier transform, of weight 1/2. Controls: flux 3 with spin structure (0, 0) leaves the span under tau + 1 (0.51), with (1/2, 0) or (0, 1/2) under -1/tau (0.81, 0.91). So the tensor is covariant, as the seat states. What that discharges is the covariance of this object; it is a different object from frame C (three theta sections on the fibre, six Higgs modes), and its use for masses and mixing is in later gates
